author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam Savage meets The General, the biggest character in LAIKA Studios' Wildwood, and the most advanced stop-motion puppet they've ever created. This golden eagle took years of development to create, and its complex armature is as breathtakingly beautiful as it is elegantly engineered. Senior armaturist Jeanne McIvor walks Adam through its fabrication and the features that allowed animators to control every muscle and feather on this majestic bird. 

Wildwood is in theaters now and tickets are available at: https://wildwoodmovie.com/
Adam Savage Meets the Stop-Motion Puppets of LAIKA Studios: https://youtu.be/9stm18DFD08
Adam Savage Tours the LAIKA Studios Model Shop: https://youtu.be/joYBiW9K07s

Shot by Joey Fameli and Josh Self
